checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same person, curly dark hair retained
must.why: Similar face and curly dark hair; the face is slightly different (smiling, a bit more mature) but plausibly the same.
Navy blazer over a white blouse.
The background is an office with windows and plants, blurred, not plain grey.

must.item: Square, centred head-and-shoulders, full hair top visible
must.why: The image is portrait (about 928x1152), not square, and it is framed to the waist. The hair top is visible.

must.item: Natural lighting and skin, no artifacts
must.why: It looks natural and photographic. The expression changed to a smile and a necklace was added.

faults.what: The background is a busy office with plants and windows, not plain light grey.
The output is not square and the framing is looser than head-and-shoulders.
The expression changed from neutral to a broad smile, and a necklace was added. Both are small identity drift.

summary: The result is a good-quality professional headshot with a navy blazer and curly hair kept, but the background is an office rather than plain grey and the image is not square.
